mixlab: 0.110.0 or newer (state_lr on mamba3-canonical requires it)
config: 6x mamba3-canonical, seq_len 16000, batch_tokens 64000, lr 0.01, lr_schedule_steps 127260, seed 2222
finding: A matched state_lr of 0.001 on A_log/dt_bias did not prevent divergence at global lr 0.01: treatment diverged at step 834, control at 762.
not_established: Where the instability originates, and whether state_lr delays it. 834 vs 762 is not a difference: onsets span 263-1011 at n=1 per cell. Both cells failing rules out this particular remedy; it does not localise the cause to any part of the block. Lowering the global learning rate does prevent it, but that changes every parameter group, not just the dynamics tensors.

lr_0p01_divergence_onsets.note: Six observed lr=0.01 runs, all diverged. Five of the six broke inside the 1,000 step warmup; the sixth broke at 1011, just past it. The 834 and 762 cells below are two of these six.
